Solve directly: P=(x,6−x) with PA=PO.

The perpendicular bisector of OA: O(0,0), A(10,−10). Midpoint (5,−5), slope of OA is −1, so the bisector has slope 1: y+5 = x−5, i.e. y = x−10.

Intersect with y = −x+6: x−10 = −x+6, so x = 8, y = −2. P = (8,−2).

Check: PO² = 64+4 = 68. PA² = (2)²+(−8)² = 4+64 = 68. ✓.

None of the solutions gives (8,−2): Solution 1 gives (−2,8), Solution 2 gives (5,1), Solution 3 gives (1,5).
